name: Orrin Kinley
role: Worker on the Medora-Deadwood stage route
bio: Orrin "Nich" Kinley returned from Deadwood with Robert Roberts in February 1884 and in May 1884 wounded his foot when his revolver went off by accident. In November 1884 he was working on the Medora-Deadwood stage route, getting the line ready for winter.

moments.label: Wounded in the foot by his own revolver
Returned from readying the stage route for winter

mentions: Robert Roberts and Orin Kinley returned from Deadwood Tuesday evening.
Orrin Kinley, better known as "Nich" received a severe wound in the foot Tuesday from the accidental discharge of his revolver. He will be all right in a week or two.
Orrin Kinley returned Tuesday from work on the stage route, and reports the line as being nearly ready for winter. He starts back to-day to complete the work.
…eadwood on the Medora stage Tuesday were Mr. and Mrs. N. C. Ludgen, H. M. Janlund, E. D. Morse, M. Franke, O. Kinley, W. Tolbert.
Tuesday's stage from Deadwood made the trip in 36 hours and 5 minutes. If you want to go to the Hills in a hurry, take the M. S. & F. Co.'s route.
…uck, Mrs. Hawley, W. W. Driskill, K. P. Aldis. Departures are Mrs. M. Liebman, A. L. Gossage, Wm. Luce, Orrin Kinley, D. Robinson, A. Adams.
